# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Our philosophy

## Mental healthcare deserves
## better technology partners

Built on therapeutic ethics, not extraction economics.
These principles guide every decision.

[Remove economic barriers]

### Remove economic barriers

Technology costs shouldn’t block access to care or practice growth. Any cost should justify itself
by offering value.

[Clinician governance]

### Clinician governance

Therapists should have binding power over decisions that affect their independence.

[Permanent independence]

### Permanent independence

We build for decades, not exit timelines.

[Ethical data utilization]

### Ethical data utilization

Data should serve care, not profit.

[Transparent operations]

### Transparent operations

Trust requires visibility and accountability.

Features you helped us build

## One unified system that answers to you.

MediSprout features and apps don't just co-exist, they work together and serve you at every point in
the care lifecycle.

[Access & Intake]
Access & Intake

Access & IntakeCare DeliveryAdministration

### Access & Intake

Jumpstart strong therapeutic alliances with a superior patient portal, intake, calendar, and
scheduling tools.

[Patient Portal]

#### Patient Portal

Drop complexities. Empower patients and families with simplified access to care and greater account
visibility.
* Dedicated and native smartphone patient apps
* Online visit requests, join visits from virtually anywhere
* One email address and one account for all family members
* Full parent or guardian access and account management

[Scheduling & Calendar]

#### Scheduling & Calendar

Organize every moment. Use robust scheduling and calendar capabilities to help you streamline
bookings and maximize your day.
* Online patient appointment requests, video or in-person
* Personalized confirmations and reminders
* Augmented calendar to see your entire week
* Customizable and robust settings and options

### Care Delivery

Count on high-quality telehealth, AI notes, automated tasks, and hundreds of other tools and
features to support what you love to do, not take it away.

[Telehealth]

#### Telehealth

With integrated, high-quality, and HIPAA-compliant video, MediSprout telehealth technology feels
almost invisible so you can focus on the visit.
* HIPAA-compliant, private, and secure
* Built HD-quality video
* Document sharing, screen sharing, chat, picture-in-picture
* Invite other family members or clinicians to join

[Notes & Records]

#### Notes & Records

Put more time back in your day with optional AI-assisted note taking and sharable patient-controlled
records.
* Optional AI-generated notes with various templates
* Customizable templates per specialty
* Auto-populated treatment plans
* One-click chart sharing with referrals

### Administration

Move routine tasks to the background with automated billing and claims processing in a highly secure
and private platform.

[Billing]

#### Billing

Get hours back in your day and more revenue in the bank with automated claims processing.
* Automated claims processing saves hours daily
* Auto-generated superbills and insurance forms
* Real-time eligibility verification
* Private pay invoicing with instant payouts

[Security & Privacy]

#### Security & Privacy

Trust in an independently audited security system to safeguard the integrity of your practice data.
* SOC 2 Type II certified infrastructure
* End-to-end encryption at rest & in transit
* Role-based access controls
* Automatic audit logging

[Therapist at desk with practice management calendar open on laptop]

Private Pay or Insurance

## Make your own rules. Make insurers follow them.
* Manage your preferred payment model efficiently and seamlessly.
* Skip the complexities of insurance-driven platforms with a smart and flexible design.
* Automate admin tasks, put hours back in your day, and capture more revenue.
* Turn claims processing into steps you can almost forget about.

[Explore private pay][47][Explore insurance][48]

MEDISPROUT APPS

## Mobile technology designed around people, not transactions.

Explore practice management apps built the way clinicians think.

For therapists

### MyPractice Assistant

The MyPractice Assistant app unifies workflows, communications, and care data so you can strengthen
the therapeutic relationship and deliver better care outcomes.

For patients

### MyMedi Health

The patient experience has been ignored for too long. Offer best-in-class technology that

Technology costs shouldn’t block access to care or practice growth. Any cost should justify itself
by offering value.

Therapists should have binding power over decisions that affect their independence.

We build for decades, not exit timelines.

[Ethical data utilization]

### Access & Intake

Jumpstart strong therapeutic alliances with a superior patient portal, intake, calendar, and
scheduling tools.

[Patient Portal]

#### Patient Portal

Drop complexities. Empower patients and families with simplified access to care and greater account
visibility.
* Dedicated and native smartphone patient apps
* Online visit requests, join visits from virtually anywhere
* One email address and one account for all family members
* Full parent or guardian access and account management

[Scheduling & Calendar]

#### Scheduling & Calendar

Organize every moment. Use robust scheduling and calendar capabilities to help you streamline
bookings and maximize your day.
* Online patient appointment requests, video or in-person
* Personalized confirmations and reminders
* Augmented calendar to see your entire week
* Customizable and robust settings and options

### Care Delivery

Count on high-quality telehealth, AI notes, automated tasks, and hundreds of other tools and
features to support what you love to do, not take it away.

[Telehealth]

#### Telehealth

With integrated, high-quality, and HIPAA-compliant video, MediSprout telehealth technology feels
almost invisible so you can focus on the visit.
* HIPAA-compliant, private, and secure
* Built HD-quality video
* Document sharing, screen sharing, chat, picture-in-picture
* Invite other family members or clinicians to join

[Notes & Records]

#### Notes & Records

Put more time back in your day with optional AI-assisted note taking and sharable patient-controlled
records.
* Optional AI-generated notes with various templates
* Customizable templates per specialty
* Auto-populated treatment plans
* One-click chart sharing with referrals

### Administration

Move routine tasks to the background with automated billing and claims processing in a highly secure
and private platform.

[Billing]

#### Billing

Get hours back in your day and more revenue in the bank with automated claims processing.
* Automated claims processing saves hours daily
* Auto-generated superbills and insurance forms
* Real-time eligibility verification
* Private pay invoicing with instant payouts

[Security & Privacy]

#### Security & Privacy

Trust in an independently audited security system to safeguard the integrity of your practice data.
* SOC 2 Type II certified infrastructure
* End-to-end encryption at rest & in transit
* Role-based access controls
* Automatic audit logging

# Virtual Physical Therapy
# Designed **Just For You**

Providing accessible virtual physical therapy for patients, employers and partners. With the help of
the very latest HIPAA-compliant telehealth software, we have modernized and advanced physical
therapy practices that help patients recover.

[Request Screening][30]

## **Agile Virtual PT Patient Journey**

A proven solution for providing exceptional care. Our team will assist with payment options and
schedule you with an educated, licensed physical therapist to begin your personalized care plan.

## Getting to
## Know You

Our Agile virtual care team will guide you from appointment request, through to payment options,
insurance verification and your first evaluation set-up.

* [Payment Options][32]
* [States We Serve][33]

## What We Treat

Our Agile virtual care team will guide you from initial appointment request, through to pay. Our
team treats common conditions associated with musculosketal injuries [and pain points] as well as a
growing list of specialties.

[Learn More][34]

## Meet Your
## Therapist

Agile physical therapists are all liscensed PTs, not health coaches, and are able to diagnosis
musculosketal issues. Additionally, all are experienced in providing virtual care.

[Our Therapists][35]

## Personalized
## Care Plan

Agile physical therapists can pinpoint and assess your cause of pain and create personalized
treatment plans. The same physical therapist will treat you throughout the full course of care.

#### I have had such an incredible experience with Katie – the comforts of virtual visits amidst a
#### hectic work and social schedule have made my recovery much easier! I appreciate all the
#### support!

Devon S

## **Featured Physical Therapists **

[Jennifer Riley]

#### Jennifer Riley

I love to empower my patients to get better. Educating patients can help them take control of their
own health and wellness. It feels great to help a person relieve their pain, improve their physical
performance or just return to day-to-day function.

[Vinny Martin]

#### Vinny Martin

I love working with people to achieve their goals to get them back to the activities that they enjoy
in life. I like breaking down movement patterns and correcting insufficiencies to help patients
perform pain free movements.

[Jack Chan-Imai]

#### Jack Chan-Imai

The reason I got into physical therapy was to help others to improve their health through movement
and exercise. My profession allows me to provide healthcare that is natural, individualized, and
evidence-based. It is gratifying to empower and teach individuals to understand their own bodies in
order to heal themselves.

[Christina Woytal]

#### Christina Woytal

Physical therapy has been a passion of mine for 22 years. I enjoy working with patients and helping
them achieve their goals. Virtual physical therapy has allowed me to reach more people who are on a
journey to improve their function and lives. I find that the quality of interaction is just as good
as in person and the patients are very successful.

## **Where We Provide Care**

Licensed to operate in 40+ states, Agile Virtual PT has a wide footprint and the ability to help
patients in locations throughout the country. If you reside in any of these states, one of our
licensed providers would be happy to help you.

# Move Better. Live Better.

Celebrating 30 Years of Champion Moments

**Discover the power of physical therapy as your first choice to address and overcome joint and
muscle issues. With in-clinic, online and hybrid physical therapy available, we bring your
personalized care plan to you, helping you recover quicker. Why wait? Your journey to a better life
is just one step away, and it begins at ATI.**

[Request An Appointment][65]

#### Begin Your Recovery Journey Today

# Why Choose ATI Physical Therapy?

At ATI Physical Therapy, we’re committed to putting your well-being first by providing you with
industry-leading care and personalized treatment plans based on your unique needs. Schedule your
first appointment today and let us help you live the life you deserve!

[A satisfied ATI patient graduating from care]
[Learn More About PT][66]
* Find Relief Without a Referral
  
  With many insurance plans*, no prescription or doctor’s referral is needed to start your journey
  to a pain-free life.
  
  **Subject to Payer Requirements, Conditions and Limitations May Apply*
* Quality Care Wherever You Are
  
  By offering appointments within 24-48 hours at one of our 850+ clinics nationwide or in the
  comfort of your own home via hybrid or online therapy, ATI makes it easy to live pain free.
* Your Well-Being Comes First
  
  With over 80,000 five-star Google reviews and a 90% patient-satisfaction rate, our top priority is
  your health and happiness.
* Innovative Treatments, Personalized Healing
  
  Our therapists blend innovative, data-driven techniques with a thoughtful, hands-on approach to
  support you throughout your personalized recovery journey.
Knee Back Shoulder Pelvic

### Where Does it Hurt?

# Knee Pain

Our therapists target issues from arthritis to sports injuries, helping you regain stability,
strength, and freedom of movement. Whether it’s a minor twinge or post-surgery rehabilitation, we’ve
got your knees covered.

[Knee Pain Page][67]
[ATI therapist assisting a patient with knee pain]

### Where Does it Hurt?

# Back Pain

We address everything from chronic lower back issues to acute injuries. Using advanced techniques
and personalized care, we’ll help you stand tall, move freely, and say goodbye to back discomfort.

[Back Pain Page][68]
[ATI therapist assisting a patient with back pain]

### Where Does it Hurt?

# Shoulder Pain

Shoulder pain can limit your everyday activities. Our therapists are skilled in treating rotator
cuff injuries, frozen shoulders, and more. We’ll work with you to restore range of motion, reduce
pain, and help you return to your favorite activities.

[Shoulder Pain Page][69]
[ATI therapist assisting a patient with shoulder pain]

### Where Does it Hurt?

# Pelvic Pain

Our specialized pelvic health therapists offer discreet, compassionate care for issues like
incontinence, pelvic floor weakness, and pregnancy-related discomfort.

[Pelvic Pain Page][70]
[ATI therapist assisting a patient with pelvic pain]

#### Strength in Every Step

# Our Services

From injury recovery to performance enhancement, we’re equipped to help you achieve your health and
wellness goals. With both in-clinic and online options available, we ensure that high-quality care
is always within reach.

# Move Better. Live Better.

Celebrating 30 Years of Champion Moments

**Discover the power of physical therapy as your first choice to address and overcome joint and
muscle issues. With in-clinic, online and hybrid physical therapy available, we bring your
personalized care plan to you, helping you recover quicker. Why wait? Your journey to a better life
is just one step away, and it begins at ATI.**

[Request An Appointment][65]

#### Begin Your Recovery Journey Today

# Why Choose ATI Physical Therapy?

At ATI Physical Therapy, we’re committed to putting your well-being first by providing you with
industry-leading care and personalized treatment plans based on your unique needs. Schedule your
first appointment today and let us help you live the life you deserve!

[A satisfied ATI patient graduating from care]
[Learn More About PT][66]
* Find Relief Without a Referral
  
  With many insurance plans*, no prescription or doctor’s referral is needed to start your journey
  to a pain-free life.
  
  **Subject to Payer Requirements, Conditions and Limitations May Apply*
* Quality Care Wherever You Are
  
  By offering appointments within 24-48 hours at one of our 850+ clinics nationwide or in the
  comfort of your own home via hybrid or online therapy, ATI makes it easy to live pain free.
* Your Well-Being Comes First
  
  With over 80,000 five-star Google reviews and a 90% patient-satisfaction rate, our top priority is
  your health and happiness.
* Innovative Treatments, Personalized Healing
  
  Our therapists blend innovative, data-driven techniques with a thoughtful, hands-on approach to
  support you throughout your personalized recovery journey.
Knee Back Shoulder Pelvic

### Where Does it Hurt?

# Knee Pain

Our therapists target issues from arthritis to sports injuries, helping you regain stability,
strength, and freedom of movement. Whether it’s a minor twinge or post-surgery rehabilitation, we’ve
got your knees covered.

[Knee Pain Page][67]
[ATI therapist assisting a patient with knee pain]

### Where Does it Hurt?

# Back Pain

We address everything from chronic lower back issues to acute injuries. Using advanced techniques
and personalized care, we’ll help you stand tall, move freely, and say goodbye to back discomfort.

[Back Pain Page][68]
[ATI therapist assisting a patient with back pain]

### Where Does it Hurt?

# Shoulder Pain

Shoulder pain can limit your everyday activities. Our therapists are skilled in treating rotator
cuff injuries, frozen shoulders, and more. We’ll work with you to restore range of motion, reduce
pain, and help you return to your favorite activities.

[Shoulder Pain Page][69]
[ATI therapist assisting a patient with shoulder pain]

### Where Does it Hurt?

# Pelvic Pain

Our specialized pelvic health therapists offer discreet, compassionate care for issues like
incontinence, pelvic floor weakness, and pregnancy-related discomfort.

[Pelvic Pain Page][70]
[ATI therapist assisting a patient with pelvic pain]

#### Strength in Every Step

# Our Services

From injury recovery to performance enhancement, we’re equipped to help you achieve your health and
wellness goals. With both in-clinic and online options available, we ensure that high-quality care
is always within reach.

completes 90 days of employment.

your name on their online application.

building a stronger team!

## Frequently Asked Questions

What conditions can a biokineticist help with?

We help with sports injuries, post-surgery rehab, chronic pain, mobility issues, and general fitness
and movement improvement. For Our full list view [our services page][61].

Do I need a doctor’s referral?

Some services may require a referral, but many clients can book directly. Our team will guide you on
the best approach for your needs.

Do you offer virtual sessions?

Yes! You can access our expert biokinetics programs online from the comfort of your home, with
personalised guidance from our team.

How many sessions will I need?

The number of sessions depends on your condition and goals. Our biokineticists create tailored
programs to ensure safe and effective results.

Can children and seniors attend sessions?

Absolutely! We work with all age groups to improve mobility, strength, and overall physical health
safely and effectively.

How do I book a session?

You can book online through our website, call our clinic, or request a virtual session via our
contact form.

# TELEHEALTH
# YOUR WAY

A unified telehealth platform seamlessly integrated with your EHR to streamline remote healthcare
workflows across all communication channels, whether at home, in inpatient, or outpatient settings.

[Hero-girl-8.png]

## Comprehensive telehealth solutions built for modern healthcare

[[icon-it.png]][17]

#### [At-Home Visits][18]

We go beyond the usual table stakes, and simplify virtual visits by providing healthcare-specific
tools that make remote consultations more personal, efficient, and accessible for patients and
providers alike.

[[icon-any-device.png]][19]

#### [From Carts to Clinics][20]

We make it easier to deliver care in any setting – from hospitals and clinics to schools and even
mobile stroke units (MSU). Our flexible platform connects various devices and locations, helping
care teams work together seamlessly.

[[icon-configurability.png]][21]

#### [Telesitting][22]

Remotely monitor patients across multiple rooms from a single interface, such as Epic Monitor. With
no limit on the number of concurrent streams, care teams can easily monitor patient activity,
respond quickly to concerns, and improve safety across diverse care settings.

[[icon-teams.png]][23]

#### [Extend Your Reach][24]

Our platform extends workflows beyond your EHR, seamlessly connecting with partners such as
community centers, FQHCs, and other healthcare organizations. Enable care delivery wherever needed,
eliminating technical barriers and fostering collaboration across the entire care network.

## This is where patient care is going

Today's most personalized patient engagement and telehealth experience, serving leading-edge health
systems worldwide.

[Consultation-2.jpg]

## Trusted by leading health systems

Every health system is different. One thing our customers have in common? The need for telehealth
that gives users fluid access to a positive, personalized care journey.


Check out these monthly usage numbers from one of our health systems:

[Tile-1.2.jpg]
[Tile-2.2.jpg]

## Patient Engagement built for you

Enterprise power with a boutique touch. Telehealth your way.™

[[icon-patients.png]][25]

#### Patients

Tailor your care journey

[icon-it.png]

### Healthcare-focused. Integrated. Scalable. Global.

ExtendedCare Telehealth™ is powered by Cisco, the world’s largest, most secure video and
collaboration network. EMR and clinical workflow integrations included. With HIPAA, ISO 27001, and
GDPR compliance, HITRUST certification, and industry-leading encryption. All built to grow. That’s
our definition of enterprise-class telehealth.

A unified telehealth platform seamlessly integrated with your EHR to streamline remote healthcare
workflows across all communication channels, whether at home, in inpatient, or outpatient settings.

[Hero-girl-8.png]

## Comprehensive telehealth solutions built for modern healthcare

[[icon-it.png]][17]

#### [At-Home Visits][18]

We go beyond the usual table stakes, and simplify virtual visits by providing healthcare-specific
tools that make remote consultations more personal, efficient, and accessible for patients and
providers alike.

[[icon-any-device.png]][19]

#### [From Carts to Clinics][20]

We make it easier to deliver care in any setting – from hospitals and clinics to schools and even
mobile stroke units (MSU). Our flexible platform connects various devices and locations, helping
care teams work together seamlessly.

[[icon-configurability.png]][21]

#### [Telesitting][22]

Remotely monitor patients across multiple rooms from a single interface, such as Epic Monitor. With
no limit on the number of concurrent streams, care teams can easily monitor patient activity,
respond quickly to concerns, and improve safety across diverse care settings.

[[icon-teams.png]][23]

#### [Extend Your Reach][24]

Our platform extends workflows beyond your EHR, seamlessly connecting with partners such as
community centers, FQHCs, and other healthcare organizations. Enable care delivery wherever needed,
eliminating technical barriers and fostering collaboration across the entire care network.

## This is where patient care is going

Today's most personalized patient engagement and telehealth experience, serving leading-edge health
systems worldwide.

[Consultation-2.jpg]

## Trusted by leading health systems

Every health system is different. One thing our customers have in common? The need for telehealth
that gives users fluid access to a positive, personalized care journey.


Check out these monthly usage numbers from one of our health systems:

[Tile-1.2.jpg]
[Tile-2.2.jpg]

## Patient Engagement built for you

Enterprise power with a boutique touch. Telehealth your way.™

[[icon-patients.png]][25]

our definition of enterprise-class telehealth.

# Virtual Recovery and Physical Rehabilitation on YOUR terms and at YOUR convenience

Genie Health brings the expertise of a clinical MSK (musculoskeletal) team (physiotherapists and
biokineticists) to your fingertips.

Virtual home exercise programs and therapy sessions through a state-of-the-art computer vision
driven mobile experience.

[image-3_reduced]
[ Click Here For More Information ][16]

### 
### **The Genie Platform**

Genie Health’s platform can analyze and help providers manage and monitor their patient’s orthopedic
conditions.  With secure video, Genie is fully integrated with 2D and 3D motion capture technology
for biometric tracking and analysis. Genie leverages state-of-the-art computer vision technology,
workflow integrations to help deliver a seamless resource.  With administrative dashboards, Genie
Health is transforming musculo-skeletal care delivery, occupational health and sports medicine.

[ View Video ][17]

### **Virtual Care for Real Results**

Using computer vision allows your phone to collect your performance data and send it to your
clinical monitoring team. Your team then can reach out and solve any issues, adjust your program,
keep you on task and on track, and make sure you are doing what it takes to get to optimal
recovery.  **It has been shown that less than 75% of people complete their prescribed and needed
physio sessions, and less than 80% of people ever start their home program let alone finish it.** 
Similar to not finishing your antibiotics, leaving some of your therapy prescription at the wayside
can lead to chronic problems that are harder to treat. ****

The Genie Health experience keeps you motivated, engaged, and on track for your full potential
outcomes.

### **Seamlessly Integrate with Existing EHRs and Workflows**

### Reporting

### Scheduling

### Expand the Platform to Other Verticals

**From start to finish, your team is with you every step of the way.**
1. **Meet with a physiotherapist online** and after a virtual assessment, get prescribed your custom
   monitored home exercise programme
2. **Go into the app daily** and perform your home exercise routine
3. **Meet online with your monitoring team** through in-app messages and live video calls to go over
   any issues and corrections to your programme
4. **Meet with the physio** as needed to adjust or extend your programme

Using trained algorithms through machine learning processes and virtual neural networks, your
phone’s camera can recognize several key points on your body and determine how much, how fast, and
well you are moving.  These data points get stored without having to store the video of you doing
the activity.  It requires a good internet connection, well lit area, no distractions (pets, kids,
people) in the frame, and loose clothing can obviously obscure the ability to recognize the points
on the body

# Informed Clinical & Financial Consent Conditions

## Clinical Consent - Enhanced Spinal Conservative Care Pilot Programme

This consent applies to the practices of Buhrs Physiotherapist Inc & Herbst JA Biokineticist Inc

Please read these terms and conditions carefully, as they are important in clarifying and managing
expectations and form the basis of your consent to treatment. If you have any questions, please
contact your administrator or healthcare practitioner through the App, who will assist you with your
query.

Online Exercise Programme
1.  The progress of your physical recovery will be monitored through the App. You will first be
    assessed by a physiotherapist through the App. A physiotherapist will then prepare an exercise
    programme for you, which will be loaded onto your profile on the App after your first session. 
    The exercise programme will be designed to improve your recovery.
2.  It will consist of several sessions, specific to your needs. The programme is typically for 8 –
    12 weeks long, and may be extended for additional 4-week periods should this be recommended. 
    Your exercise sessions will be scheduled on the App. You will be monitored remotely by a team of
    biokineticists and/or physiotherapists, in an asynchronous manner. This means that you will not
    be monitored in real-time but may have a real-time consultation with a practitioner from time to
    time, should this be required. A video of your exercises will not be stored, although the
    completion of your pain scores and compliance with the programme will be reviewed regularly.
    While we will try to ensure that the same practitioner monitors you during all your sessions,
    this may not always be possible. Different practitioners may, therefore, monitor you during the
    sessions.
3.  There will be no physical in-person contact with your attending practitioner (physiotherapist /
    biokineticist). Your evaluation will be done, and your progress monitored through the
    App *only*. If the attending practitioner is of the opinion that you need to consult a
    healthcare practitioner in person, you will be referred to an appropriate practitioner. We
    cannot be held responsible should you injure yourself while performing your exercises. Therefor,
    if you feel uncomfortable at any time during the exercises, you must immediately stop and
    contact the attending practitioner who will guide you further.
4.  The programme is not intended to replace, but rather complement any treatment that you are
    currently receiving. You may continue to consult your preferred healthcare practitioners while
    you follow the exercise programme on the App.
5.  The benefits of receiving the services on the App include the following:
    * Lower cost than receiving in-person treatment;
    * Performing the exercises in the comfort of your own space (such as your home) with no need to
      travel to a healthcare practitioner;
    * Better outcomes compared to when exercises are done without monitoring by a healthcare
      practitioner;
    * Higher patient satisfaction due to the feedback and support received through remote
      monitoring.
6.  It is important that you complete the exercise programme to fully benefit from it. If you do not
    keep up with the required frequency and accuracy of exercises you may experience poor outcomes
7.  It is also important that you follow the instructions precisely with every exercise and give
    accurate feedback on pain levels. Failure to do so may result in injury, strain, or pain. If you
    do not report your pain scale accurately on the App, the exercises prescribed may be
    inappropriate for you.
8.  Interactions with the physiotherapist and biokineticist will only occur through the App. To
    ensure that this can be done successfully, please ensure that the device you use is of good
    quality. You must also ensure that you have sufficient data and that the data transmission speed
    is of good quality. Your device and data should meet the following requirements:
    * Mobile phone or tablet
      * Android – version 8.0 or later
      * iPhone – iOS 15. 0 or later
      * iPad – iPad OS 15.0 or later
      * iPod touch – iOS 15. 0 or later
      * Mac – Mac OS 12.0 or later with Apple M1 chip or later
    * Data speed requirements: 4Mb per second or faster
9.  The costs for the services (evaluation, exercise programme and remote monitoring) are described
    in the document entitled “Financial Consent”. The costs of the device you use to run the App on
    and any data costs incurred to access the App and to engage with a practitioner remotely are for
    your own account.
10. You should be aware that if you have an unstable internet connection while using the App, you
    may experience a time delay. There may also be a delay in feedback from the attending
    practitioner should your exercises not be updated. This may impact the evaluation of:

2.  It will consist of several sessions, specific to your needs. The programme is typically for 8 –
    12 weeks long, and may be extended for additional 4-week periods should this be recommended. 
    Your exercise sessions will be scheduled on the App. You will be monitored remotely by a team of
    biokineticists and/or physiotherapists, in an asynchronous manner. This means that you will not
    be monitored in real-time but may have a real-time consultation with a practitioner from time to
    time, should this be required. A video of your exercises will not be stored, although the
    completion of your pain scores and compliance with the programme will be reviewed regularly.
    While we will try to ensure that the same practitioner monitors you during all your sessions,

    if you feel uncomfortable at any time during the exercises, you must immediately stop and
    contact the attending practitioner who will guide you further.
4.  The programme is not intended to replace, but rather complement any treatment that you are
    currently receiving. You may continue to consult your preferred healthcare practitioners while
    you follow the exercise programme on the App.
5.  The benefits of receiving the services on the App include the following:
    * Lower cost than receiving in-person treatment;
    * Performing the exercises in the comfort of your own space (such as your home) with no need to
      travel to a healthcare practitioner;
    * Better outcomes compared to when exercises are done without monitoring by a healthcare

    do not report your pain scale accurately on the App, the exercises prescribed may be

###### FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ View More ][176]
Do you accept insurance?

We want care to be accessible for everyone. That’s why we work with many insurance providers, and
we’ll gladly help you check if your plan covers chiropractic services. If you’re unsure, just give
us a call — we’ll walk you through the details.

How do I know which treatment option is right for me?

We want care to be accessible for everyone. That’s why we work with many insurance providers, and
we’ll gladly help you check if your plan covers chiropractic services. If you’re unsure, just give
us a call — we’ll walk you through the details.

Can I get a same-day appointment?

We understand that discomfort and pain can’t always wait. Our team makes every effort to offer
same-day appointments whenever possible. Availability may depend on your specific needs and our
schedule, but we’ll always do our best to see you quickly.

What should I expect during my first visit?

Your first visit is all about understanding your needs. We’ll start with a conversation about your
health, followed by an exam to pinpoint the source of your concerns. From there, we’ll explain your
options and create a personalized care plan so you know exactly what to expect moving forward.

### Need Help Finding Care?
### Our 24/7 Contact Center is Here for You!

### SCAN ME

We understand that finding the right care can be challenging. That’s why our dedicated team is
available 24/7 to provide support and assistance. Whether you need to schedule an appointment or
have questions about our services, we’re here to make it easy for you to get the care you need.

[ CALL NOW (0917) 466-2273 ][153]

# Why our kind of care is what you need

### Humanized Healthcare for Everyone

Behind your health condition, HMN understands who you are – a person with varying, complex needs.
That’s why we take time to get to know you, so we can provide better care for you.

### We Give Our All, For One

Every patient gets a team of healthcare providers combining their expertise to address your complete
healthcare needs. This is how our team of doctors, nurses, and staff work together to make you feel
better holistically.

# What Patients Say About Their Experience With Us

"Natutuwa ako doon sa mga tao doon. Talagang accommodating sila, kahit saan, sa X-ray room, talagang

Every pain is a message, and at Integrity Rehab, we're fluent in responding. Whether it's persistent
back and neck pain, sports-related injuries, pelvic dysfunction, discomfort from arthritis, or the
nagging aches in your knees and feet, we have tailored strategies to address each challenge. Dive
into our detailed resources and discover how our expert treatments turn conditions into stories of
recovery and resilience.

## Hear From Our Recovered Patients

**The best place for your recovery!**

I have been impressed with my treatment plan they have been providing me, the care and concern of
the staff, the members, the facility is well kept, clean, and relaxing. I would highly recommend
anyone who would like to be treated as human and have their issues managed, this is the place.

### - Ernest L.

**They helped me heal!**

Great workout today in effort of recovery from a compression injury from attempting the Army knee
tuck a couple years ago (which is now not required). Thankful to still be here in recovery while
many of my Comrades were chaptered out of the Army for their ACFT injuries and are still trying to
recover. May we all continue to heal!

### - Lisa N.

**Professional & caring!**

They work with you with care and give you great suggestions.

### - Joyce K.

**The best place for physical therapy!**

Integrity is the premier company in rehab. The staff brings compassion, personalization, expertise
and joyful motivation that brings that brings rapid healing. That balance brings a delight of
accomplishment and smiles to the patients. It did me ☺️ thanks ❤️

### - Jeanie K.

**Professional, knowledgeable & caring!**

Mikayla Kenney is a very knowledgeable physical therapist. She makes the visit comfortable and
enjoyable. Mikayla makes sure I understand each exercise and the purpose of it, also if the exercise
is causing any discomfort or pain. Integrity Rehab is a very clean and comfortable location, the
staff is very courteous and helpful.

**They give you the tools to feel better!**

Had good, detailed therapy during my appointment and I left with more exercises to help with my home
therapy.

Everything is great. I’m very lucky to have you helping me with my physical issues. Dr. Selina,

  ## [What Is an RDL and Why Should You Do Them?][125]
  
  An RDL, or Romanian deadlift, is a strength-training exercise that teaches the hip-hinge movement.
  Instead of squatting down, you push your hips back, keep your spine neutral, and use your
  hamstrings and glutes to control the weight. The RDL helps train the posterior chain muscles that
  support bending, lifting, and running. It’s used for everything…

You likely clicked on this link with a desire to know how to treat your own back pain. **You’ve come
to the right place.**

designed J.O.Y. Virtual Physical Therapy to a custom-treat your back pain. In just 10 short minutes,
you will have the education, exercise and posture prescription that fits YOU, and be on your way to
healing.

Grite Brunker began swimming because it gave her something to do in her small, Lithuanian village.

Lithuanian-to-English dictionary and not much else, Grite moved nearly 5,000 miles away to swim for

risky plunge into deep waters.

# Outpatient Physical Therapy

We’re part of the largest physical therapy network in the U.S. With almost 2,000 outpatient physical
therapy centers and 7,000-plus licensed therapists, we’re a leader in physical therapy excellence.

We’re also your partner in wellness. We offer occupational and hand therapy, sports medicine,

Our focus every day is on exceptional patient care. Your health and wellness goals are our goals. We

[A child with glasses sits on her mother's lap while the daughter is using her tablet]
Augmentative and alternative communication - helping kids connect through pediatric speech therapy
When it comes to kids with communication difficulties, high-tech and screen time often tip the scale
toward good rather than bad for many reasons. Learn how high-tech communication tools enhance work
done with pediatric speech therapists to help kids understand and communicate with the world around
them.
[Click here to learn more][70]
[Grite diving into the pool.]
Clinician Spotlight: Grite Brunker
Grite Brunker began swimming because it gave her something to do in her small, Lithuanian village.
As she became one of the best sprint swimmers in her country, opportunities flooded in. Carrying a
Lithuanian-to-English dictionary and not much else, Grite moved nearly 5,000 miles away to swim for
and attend the University of Louisville. Sixteen years later, she has a doctorate in physical
therapy, manages a KORT center in Louisville, teaches college courses and has zero regrets about her
risky plunge into deep waters.
[Read Grite's story][71]
[Therapist taking blood pressure of patient in their home]
Home sweet home – when rehabilitation services come to you
When injury or illness makes it difficult to leave home for therapy services to get you stronger,
our in-home therapy and home health program comes to you. We bridge the gap, making it possible to
gain strength, mobility and more to regain independence and rejoin life.
[Learn more about our services][72]
[Patient and physical therapist sit on a bench and smile while working together on therapy
exercises.]

THE PATIENT EXPERIENCE

[Patient and physical therapist sit on a bench and smile while working together on therapy
exercises.]

### Your trusted therapy partner

At KORT Physical Therapy, we partner with you to heal, relieve pain and get back to the things that
are important to you.

Our movement experts listen, provide individualized, compassionate care and work as a trusted part
of your health care team to help achieve your goals. Together, we work to regain your strength and
confidence.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about high-risk merchant accounts

### What is a high-risk merchant account?

A high-risk merchant account is a payment processing account specifically designed for businesses
that traditional banks consider higher risk due to industry type, processing history, or business
model. These specialized accounts enable businesses in industries like CBD, travel, online gaming,
and nutraceuticals to process credit card payments despite being declined by conventional
processors.

### Why is my business considered high-risk?

Businesses may be classified as high-risk for several reasons: operating in regulated industries
(CBD, firearms), having high chargeback rates, offering subscription billing models, selling
age-restricted products, being new businesses with limited processing history, or operating
internationally. This classification doesn't reflect the legitimacy of your business but rather the
perceived processing risk from traditional banking perspectives.

### How long does approval take for a high-risk merchant account?

With Kosipay, most high-risk merchant accounts are approved within 24-72 hours, significantly faster
than the industry average of 1-2 weeks. Our streamlined application process and specialized
underwriting team allow us to expedite approvals while maintaining thorough compliance checks. After
approval, account setup and integration typically take an additional 1-3 business days.

### What are the processing rates for high-risk merchant accounts?

Processing rates for high-risk merchant accounts typically range from 2.5% to 5.0% per transaction
plus a small per-transaction fee. Your specific rate depends on your industry, processing volume,
business history, and chargeback rates. Kosipay offers competitive, transparent pricing with no
hidden fees, and we provide customized quotes based on your specific business profile.

### Do you require a rolling reserve for high-risk merchant accounts?

Some high-risk merchant accounts may require a rolling reserve, which is a percentage of your
processing volume held in reserve to cover potential chargebacks. Not all accounts require reserves,
and Kosipay works to minimize or eliminate reserves when possible. When required, reserves typically
range from 5-10% and are fully returned to you after a predetermined period, usually 6 months.

### What payment methods can I accept with a high-risk merchant account?

Kosipay high-risk merchant accounts support all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American
Express, Discover), debit cards, ACH payments, and alternative payment methods like digital wallets.
We also offer cryptocurrency processing solutions and international payment options for businesses
with global customers, ensuring you can serve all your customers regardless of their preferred
payment method.

Processing rates for high-risk merchant accounts typically range from 2.5% to 5.0% per transaction
plus a small per-transaction fee. Your specific rate depends on your industry, processing volume,
business history, and chargeback rates. Kosipay offers competitive, transparent pricing with no
hidden fees, and we provide customized quotes based on your specific business profile.

### Do you require a rolling reserve for high-risk merchant accounts?

Some high-risk merchant accounts may require a rolling reserve, which is a percentage of your
processing volume held in reserve to cover potential chargebacks. Not all accounts require reserves,
and Kosipay works to minimize or eliminate reserves when possible. When required, reserves typically
range from 5-10% and are fully returned to you after a predetermined period, usually 6 months.

### What payment methods can I accept with a high-risk merchant account?

Kosipay high-risk merchant accounts support all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American
Express, Discover), debit cards, ACH payments, and alternative payment methods like digital wallets.
We also offer cryptocurrency processing solutions and international payment options for businesses
with global customers, ensuring you can serve all your customers regardless of their preferred
payment method.

high-quality & personalized medical care to his patients and the community. He valued the
relationships he built with his patients and was remembered for never missing a patient's funeral.
In 1999, Dr. Mariam Maniya took over and infused the practice with her passion for getting to know
her patients holistically as a person and always putting the patient's needs first. 50 years later,
despite our growth, we're still family & physician owned and operated, and we still believe creating
and nurturing lasting personal relationships with our patients is the most important thing we do. We
also believe the point of a doctor is to be there when you need them most, and we work daily to live
up to that promise.  That's what distinguishes Maniya Health from the big hospital systems and the
national franchises where patients are treated like a number.
 
In 2020, as COVID exposed how broken the health care system was, Dr. Omar Maniya recognized that we
had to reinvent ourselves. Using technology like telemedicine and connected devices, we reimagined
our care model to bring it into the 21st century. We also reimagined the entire patient experience -
it's easy for doctors to say "do this test" or "see this specialist," but actually getting it done
can sometimes feel impossible. That's why we eliminated our no-show and cancellation policy - we get
it, life happens. And that's also why we incorporated rapid COVID/Flu testing, on-site labs &
radiology, evening hours until 8pm, guaranteed same-day appointments, walk-in visits, telehealth and
speciality care.

Pulmonology, Sleep Medicine, Neurology, Rheumatology, General Surgery, Podiatry, Joint Injections,
IV Infusions, Physical Therapy, Radiology & Dietitians. We've been fortunate to have recruited an
amazing team of Physicians who are leaders in their fields to provide our patients with the highest
quality care. Additionally, our 50 years of experience in the community has allowed us to form deep
relationships with local hospitals and specialists, so if we don't offer the treatment we can guide

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Data is encrypted in transfer and in storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access
rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

Yes. Telemedicine is built into the platform: turn any appointment into a video consultation with
one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

How long does it take to get started?

You can be ready to book patients in about 10 minutes: create your schedule, add services and share
your online booking link. Our team helps with setup and data transfer during free onboarding
consultations.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Data is encrypted in transfer and in storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access
rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

Yes. Telemedicine is built into the platform: turn any appointment into a video consultation with
one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

How long does it take to get started?

You can be ready to book patients in about 10 minutes: create your schedule, add services and share
your online booking link. Our team helps with setup and data transfer during free onboarding
consultations.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

Every bank and payment processor has its own set of standards according to which it evaluates
businesses. Some processors classify certain products as "high-risk" when they're more likely to
attract fraud, result in chargebacks, or face regulatory challenges. These include: • CBD and
cannabis-related products • Nutritional supplements and weight loss items • Financial services like
debt consolidation • Gambling and gaming sites • Travel packages and accommodations • Adult
entertainment content • Subscription services with recurring billing

   Mountain Range of Motion, LLC provides mobile physical therapy services locally to Madison, ME
and Carrabassett Valley area as well as telehealth physical therapy for individuals located in the
states of Maine, Massachusetts, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Florida. Our physical therapy
evaluations and treatment focus on rehabilitation for mountain sports, outdoor activities, return to
active lifestyle and pain management. Our online wellness services are designed as activity specific
fitness and injury prevention for individuals worldwide.


   Our mission is to increase access to physical therapy and wellness services in rural areas, and
allow for convenience of care for those with limited time, transportation or mobility. Mobile and

home, work place, or outdoor environment.

patient access. Our goal is to get your treatment started faster so that you can get back to your
daily activities with less pain and increased quality of motion and mobility.


   Wellness services are available as individual sessions, online classes, and subscription plans.

## Movement is how we live.dance.walk.love.jump.hug.play.

If you can move well, you can live well. But caring for your body in today’s healthcare system can
be frustrating. We knew there must be a better way – that’s why we started MovementX.

## How It Works

## **How It Works**

[Phone icon]

### Book Your Session

**[Sign up now][128] **and choose any MovementX provider who specializes in the care you need ([or
get matched with one][129]). Get seen within 3 days—no prescription needed.

[On site physical therapy map icon]

### **Choose Care Anywhere**

At your home, at our nearby PT clinics, at your local gym, or virtually—you pick. We’ll adapt to
your busy work and family schedule. That’s convenience redefined.

[running icon move your best]

### Start Moving Better

With 1-on-1 personalized sessions for a full 60 minutes, you’ll achieve your goals quicker than
other options. Recover from injury, increase strength, and optimize your health.

## OUR SPECIALIZED SERVICES

### **Work With an Expert For Your Unique Needs **

MovementX physical therapists and personal trainers are highly experienced, carefully chosen, and
full-time employees who are deeply passionate about helping you achieve your movement goals.

We help people of all ages and abilities avoid medications, injections, surgeries, or chronic levels
of pain. Click to learn more about the wide array of orthopedic, sports, neurologic, and other
specialized services we offer.

## **Your Options for Payment**

[Pay Direct Icon MovementX]

### **1. Pay Direct**

You can pay out-of-pocket after each session, which cost about $200 on average (varies per
provider). Bundle packages help you save, or you can use your Health Savings Account (HSA) or
Flexible Spending Account (FSA).

[Book a Session Now][170]

**★ **MOST POPULAR** ★**

[Get Reimbursed Icon MovementX]

### **2. Get Reimbursed**

Does your insurance plan offer out-of-network benefits? If so, you can pay out-of-pocket, submit
receipts to your insurance carrier, and receive a check from them in the mail. Chat with us or
[click here][171] to learn more.

[Call 202-681-1474][172]

[Get Fully Covered Icon MovementX]

### 3. Get Fully Covered

If your injury is [**work-related**][173], from a **[car accident][174]**, or covered by a Christian
Sharing Ministry, the costs of your plan of care with MovementX may be fully covered. Submit your
claim information below to get started.

[Submit Your Claim][175]

# Infant & Pediatric Physical Therapy in** ** Denver, Colorado

You know your baby best. When something feels off with their movement, their milestones, or the way
they hold their head, we listen, help you understand, and support your little one to thrive.
Movevery specializes in infant physical therapy for **torticollis, head shapes, and milestones** —
gentle, whole-body care for birth to three

[ Book a Call — We'd Love to Help ][42]

## Who We Are

### Board-certified pediatric PT. In-home, clinic, and virtual. No referral needed in Colorado.

[ Book a Call with Dr. Nicole ][43]

# Is This For My Infant Or Child?

You might be in the right place if...
* Your infant or baby always looks to one side or has a head tilt (torticollis)
* You've noticed a flat spot developing on their head (positional plagiocephaly)
* Tummy time is a struggle or they seem uncomfortable
* Your little one isn't hitting milestones when you'd expect (rolling, sitting, crawling, walking)
* Your baby seems stiff or floppy
* They skip crawling and you're not sure if that's okay
* Your baby arches their back frequently or seems uncomfortable in certain positions
* Your pediatrician flagged a concern but didn't give you a next step
* You just want someone to take a real look and tell you what they see

*You don't need a referral. You don't need to wait. Book a *complimentary* call and let's talk.*

[ Book a Session ][44]
[Newborn baby wrapped in white blanket — Movevery infant and pediatric physical therapy Denver]

Movevery specializes in infant physical therapy for [torticollis][45]**, **[head shape
concerns][46]**, **and [milestones][47], supporting babies from birth to three with gentle,
whole-body care.

Our approach combines evidence-based techniques, [manual therapy][48], functional play, and
family-centered care to help your child move with confidence.

We believe support should begin from the very start. [Early support helps parents feel confident and
informed][49] as their baby grows, offering guidance and education during a critical window of
development.

## Our Philosophy: More Than Abstinence

Recovery is a long process, and there is no quick fix for addiction. Real change requires addressing
underlying mental and emotional challenges while building skills that support long‑term wellness. 

Nova provides clinical care based on evidence. It focuses on long-term treatment plans. We use
structured “blocks” focused on key recovery themes to help each client progress with purpose. This
approach empowers people to live independently, confidently, and free from substance use.

We treat people, not just symptoms. Our programs help people with substance use disorder and mental
health issues. We customize care to fit each person’s needs. While we provide comprehensive
treatment, we encourage anyone seeking help to consult a healthcare professional for personalized
medical advice.

## Recovery Curriculum: Structure and Connection

At Nova, recovery is built on connection and education. Our weekly treatment blocks feature two core
components:

### Process Groups: Healing Through Connection

Trained therapists lead these groups. They offer a safe space for self-reflection, emotional
exploration, and support from peers. Sessions include structured check‑ins, journaling, role‑play,
and other interactive exercises to build practical coping skills.

People learn to navigate relationships and triggers in real‑world situations, which can help them
stay sober after treatment. These process groups are one type of therapy at Nova. Other group
therapy sessions may focus on coping skills or wellness practices.

### Chemical Dependency Education (CD ED): Knowledge Is Power

Educational support groups teach the neurobiology of addiction, stress management, relapse
prevention, and other essential topics. Participants gain insight into how addiction affects the
brain and behavior and discover ways to avoid relapse. This knowledge empowers clients to make
informed decisions during their recovery process and beyond.

## Our Full Range of Drug and Alcohol Rehab Services

Nova provides drug and alcohol rehab services for every step of the recovery journey. This includes
help with withdrawal symptoms and aftercare. Our program offers medical detox, inpatient treatment,
intensive outpatient programs (IOP), and sober living programs. These services help you stay sober
and build a stable life.

### Detox Programs: A Safe Start
* [**Inpatient Detox in Austin, TX**][116]
* [**Outpatient Detox in San Antonio, TX**][117]

Our detox services provide 24/7 medical supervision, counseling, and nutritional support to ensure a
safe and comfortable withdrawal process. Detox is the first step in your recovery.

Get started with our [medically‑assisted drug & alcohol detox in Austin][118].

It helps manage withdrawal symptoms carefully. This process prepares you for further treatment. We
provide inpatient detox in Austin and outpatient detox in San Antonio. This gives you treatment
options that suit your needs.

[Inpatient or Outpatient Detox: Understanding the Differences at Nova Recovery Center][Inpatient or
Outpatient Detox: Understanding the Differences at Nova Recovery Center]

People frequently refer to these services as rehab detox programs, linking detox with formal
therapy.

Many *rehab centers* offer detox. Nova’s team designs a medically supervised approach for your
needs. It helps build a strong foundation for lasting recovery.

### Residential Inpatient Rehab: 90‑Day Recovery
* [90-Day Inpatient Rehab in Austin, TX][119]
* [90-Day Inpatient Rehab in Wimberley Campus (Near Austin)][120]

Our 90‑day inpatient program near Austin provides a safe environment for treatment and recovery.
Each client receives personalized therapy, family involvement, and chef‑prepared meals in
comfortable accommodations.

This holistic program addresses substance use disorders, supports emotional resilience, and offers
dual‑diagnosis treatment for co‑occurring mental health conditions. Separate housing and treatment
tracks for men and women help create a distraction‑free environment. Inpatient rehab is ideal for
those needing intensive support or chronic relapse prevention.

[Outpatient Drug and Alcohol Rehab | Inpatient Drug and Alcohol Rehab][Outpatient Drug and Alcohol
Rehab | Inpatient Drug and Alcohol Rehab]

Our Wimberley campus is one of several inpatient rehabs operated by Nova. These centers provide
structured care and comfortable surroundings, making them a strong choice for people comparing
different rehab centers.

### Outpatient Treatment Programs: Flexible Healing
* [**Intensive Outpatient Rehab in Austin, TX**][121]
* [**Intensive Outpatient Rehab in Colorado Springs, CO**][122]
* **[Intensive Outpatient Rehab in Houston, TX][123]**
* **[Intensive Outpatient Rehab in San Antonio, TX][124]**

For people leaving inpatient care or seeking flexible recovery, Nova offers an intensive outpatient
program (IOP). This program includes structured therapy sessions. They also provide aftercare
programs for continued support. You can participate while living independently or in sober housing.

Outpatient services provide accountability, peer support, and personalized care, so you can balance
daily responsibilities with recovery. These programs can be a great option for drug addiction
recovery. They allow you to keep your job and stay with your family. Prefer flexible care? Our
[outpatient alcohol rehab in Austin, TX][125] offers day and evening groups.

### Sober Living Programs: Transition to Independence

* [**Sober Living in Houston, TX**][127]
* [**Sober Living in San Antonio, TX**][128]
* [**Sober Living in Colorado Springs, CO**][129]
* [**Sober Living in Philadelphia, PA**][130]

helps prevent relapse. Homes include regular drug screenings, peer
