## Our Philosophy: More Than Abstinence

Recovery is a long process, and there is no quick fix for addiction. Real change requires addressing
underlying mental and emotional challenges while building skills that support long‑term wellness. 

Nova provides clinical care based on evidence. It focuses on long-term treatment plans. We use
structured “blocks” focused on key recovery themes to help each client progress with purpose. This
approach empowers people to live independently, confidently, and free from substance use.

We treat people, not just symptoms. Our programs help people with substance use disorder and mental
health issues. We customize care to fit each person’s needs. While we provide comprehensive
treatment, we encourage anyone seeking help to consult a healthcare professional for personalized
medical advice.

## Recovery Curriculum: Structure and Connection

At Nova, recovery is built on connection and education. Our weekly treatment blocks feature two core
components:

### Process Groups: Healing Through Connection

Trained therapists lead these groups. They offer a safe space for self-reflection, emotional
exploration, and support from peers. Sessions include structured check‑ins, journaling, role‑play,
and other interactive exercises to build practical coping skills.

People learn to navigate relationships and triggers in real‑world situations, which can help them
stay sober after treatment. These process groups are one type of therapy at Nova. Other group
therapy sessions may focus on coping skills or wellness practices.

### Chemical Dependency Education (CD ED): Knowledge Is Power

Educational support groups teach the neurobiology of addiction, stress management, relapse
prevention, and other essential topics. Participants gain insight into how addiction affects the
brain and behavior and discover ways to avoid relapse. This knowledge empowers clients to make
informed decisions during their recovery process and beyond.

## Our Full Range of Drug and Alcohol Rehab Services

Nova provides drug and alcohol rehab services for every step of the recovery journey. This includes
help with withdrawal symptoms and aftercare. Our program offers medical detox, inpatient treatment,
intensive outpatient programs (IOP), and sober living programs. These services help you stay sober
and build a stable life.

### Detox Programs: A Safe Start
* [**Inpatient Detox in Austin, TX**][116]
* [**Outpatient Detox in San Antonio, TX**][117]

Our detox services provide 24/7 medical supervision, counseling, and nutritional support to ensure a
safe and comfortable withdrawal process. Detox is the first step in your recovery.

Get started with our [medically‑assisted drug & alcohol detox in Austin][118].

It helps manage withdrawal symptoms carefully. This process prepares you for further treatment. We
provide inpatient detox in Austin and outpatient detox in San Antonio. This gives you treatment
options that suit your needs.

[Inpatient or Outpatient Detox: Understanding the Differences at Nova Recovery Center][Inpatient or
Outpatient Detox: Understanding the Differences at Nova Recovery Center]

People frequently refer to these services as rehab detox programs, linking detox with formal
therapy.

Many *rehab centers* offer detox. Nova’s team designs a medically supervised approach for your
needs. It helps build a strong foundation for lasting recovery.

### Residential Inpatient Rehab: 90‑Day Recovery
* [90-Day Inpatient Rehab in Austin, TX][119]
* [90-Day Inpatient Rehab in Wimberley Campus (Near Austin)][120]

Our 90‑day inpatient program near Austin provides a safe environment for treatment and recovery.
Each client receives personalized therapy, family involvement, and chef‑prepared meals in
comfortable accommodations.

This holistic program addresses substance use disorders, supports emotional resilience, and offers
dual‑diagnosis treatment for co‑occurring mental health conditions. Separate housing and treatment
tracks for men and women help create a distraction‑free environment. Inpatient rehab is ideal for
those needing intensive support or chronic relapse prevention.

[Outpatient Drug and Alcohol Rehab | Inpatient Drug and Alcohol Rehab][Outpatient Drug and Alcohol
Rehab | Inpatient Drug and Alcohol Rehab]

Our Wimberley campus is one of several inpatient rehabs operated by Nova. These centers provide
structured care and comfortable surroundings, making them a strong choice for people comparing
different rehab centers.

### Outpatient Treatment Programs: Flexible Healing

* [**Intensive Outpatient Rehab in Colorado Springs, CO**][122]
* **[Intensive Outpatient Rehab in Houston, TX][123]**
* **[Intensive Outpatient Rehab in San Antonio, TX][124]**

For people leaving inpatient care or seeking flexible recovery, Nova offers an intensive outpatient
program (IOP). This program includes structured therapy sessions. They also provide aftercare
programs for continued support. You can participate while living independently or in sober housing.

Outpatient services provide accountability, peer support, and personalized care, so you can balance
daily responsibilities with recovery. These programs can be a great option for drug addiction

At Optimal Therapy, we believe exceptional patient care starts with exceptional people. Whether
you’re an experienced clinician or just beginning your career, you’ll find mentorship, opportunities
to grow, and a team that’s committed to your success.

If you’re passionate about providing exceptional care and want to grow in a supportive,

## Welcome to the Optimal Therapy Family!

**Our outpatient physical and occupational therapy centers in Las Vegas, Henderson, Pahrump, and
Boulder City are dedicated to providing the highest quality physical therapy and occupational
therapy in Las Vegas and surrounding areas.**

**We offer pre-operative and post-operative therapy, as well as non-operative therapy for injuries
caused by work, trauma, or overuse. Every treatment plan is personalized, focusing on manual therapy
techniques and therapeutic exercises to help you regain full function, reduce pain, and enhance your
quality of life.**

**At Optimal Therapy, we are proud to be part of the Nevada community. We live here, raise our
families here, and are deeply invested in supporting our neighbors. Our commitment extends beyond
therapy—we’re here to help our community stay healthy, active, and thriving.**

## 2 Appointment Options to Serve You

At Optimal Therapy, we are committed to providing exceptional physical therapy care with flexible
options tailored to your needs. To support your recovery and overall wellness, we offer two types of
physical therapy appointments, designed to make it easier for patients across Las Vegas, Henderson,
Boulder City, and Pahrump to access the care they need.

[Optimal Therapy Horizon Clinic - Private Room]

## In Office

Come visit us for a traditional in-office physical or occupational therapy session and take full
advantage of our specialized equipment and purpose-built facilities—designed to help you recover
faster, improve mobility, and achieve your rehabilitation goals.

We believe technology can enhance your therapy experience. That’s why our skilled therapists now
offer Telehealth appointments, providing innovative exercises, personalized guidance, and expert
instruction—all from the comfort of your home, wherever you are.

## Our Company History

Founded in 1981 with a mission of providing exceptional therapy services, PTS opened its first
outpatient clinic in Morton, IL. From that point forward, we have seen steady growth in patient
volume and in the number of employees. With business growth, came the challenge of recruiting
qualified therapists in the midst of a shortage. We have met this challenge by offering flexible
work schedules and part-time hours for our employees to optimize their work-life balance.

## [The latest from our blog][173]

[
][174]

### [ Fall Prevention and Healthy Aging: How Physical Therapy Helps You Stay Strong and Independent
### ][175]

At Professional Therapy Services, Inc. (PTS), we know that fall prevention is about more than
avoiding injury. It’s about preserving independence, improving confidence, and staying engaged in
the life you love.

[ Read More » ][176]
[
][177]

### [ Life After Cancer: Finding Strength in Survivorship ][178]

Every August, we pause to recognize Oncology Month. It’s a time to raise awareness about cancer
prevention and treatment, but also to shine a light on what comes next — the survivorship journey.

For many people, life after treatment can feel just as overwhelming as the diagnosis. Rebuilding
strength, managing fatigue, and coping with the emotional impact of cancer are real challenges. At
Professional Therapy Services, Inc. (PTS), we believe survivorship deserves just as much care and
attention as treatment itself. That’s why our programs are designed to help you move forward with
strength, confidence, and support.

[ Read More » ][179]
[
][180]

### [ Growing Pains or Sports Injury? How to Tell the Difference in Active Kids ][181]

As the school year kicks off, so does the hustle of after-school practices, weekend games, and
bleacher cheering. Whether your child is chasing goals on the soccer field, swimming laps at the
pool, or swinging for the fences on the diamond, sports are a great way to stay active, build
confidence, and make lasting memories.

But let’s be real: being a sports parent also means keeping an eye out for bumps, bruises, and
sometimes more serious concerns.

[ Read More » ][182]

Every August, we pause to recognize Oncology Month. It’s a time to raise awareness about cancer
prevention and treatment, but also to shine a light on what comes next — the survivorship journey.

For many people, life after treatment can feel just as overwhelming as the diagnosis. Rebuilding
strength, managing fatigue, and coping with the emotional impact of cancer are real challenges. At
Professional Therapy Services, Inc. (PTS), we believe survivorship deserves just as much care and
attention as treatment itself. That’s why our programs are designed to help you move forward with
strength, confidence, and support.

owned infrastructure delivers.

How we do it

## One system of record. Every employment need.

### [employer-of-record-icon-product_32.webp]Employer of Record (EOR)

Need to hire anyone, anywhere? We handle the employment contract, taxes, benefits, and compliance —
onboarded in hours, not months.

### [global-payroll-icon-product_32.webp]Global Payroll

Accurate, compliant payroll in every country you operate. Run by our in-house teams, no partner
network.

### [contractor-of-record-icon-product_32.webp]Contractor of Record (COR)

Engage international contractors compliantly. Contracts, payments, and risk — all handled by our
experts.

### [contractor-management-icon-product_32.webp]Contractor Management

Engage contractors compliantly, anywhere — and convert them to FTEs before misclassification risk
becomes a legal problem.

### [peo-icon-product_32.webp]Professional Employer Organization (PEO)

US hiring without the admin burden. Payroll, taxes, benefits, all taken care of.

Intelligent infrastructure

## Owned end-to-end infrastructure, operated in-house.

We have our own legal experts, our own payroll specialists, and our own compliance teams in every
market we operate in. And because it's all ours, everything lives in one place: every employment
record, contract, compliance document, and payroll engine run accurate, current, audit-ready, **SOC
2 Type 2** compliant, and **ISO 27001 certified**.

At Results Physiotherapy, we believe that people should not have to live with pain. We are committed
to clinical excellence through professional development and industry-leading continuing education,
supported by a culture of friendship.

At Results Physiotherapy, you’ll receive world-class, personalized service from leading clinicians

## FAQs

**How can social networking benefit physicians?**

As a physician, being up-to-date on today’s medical news is essential; but remaining on the
cutting-edge of the medical world is not easy. A social network for doctors like Sermo can help
empower physicians across [medical specialties][46] to achieve their personal and professional
goals, while having fun and making meaningful connections with others.

Sermo is the only dedicated social network for doctors in the world—bringing together more than
1,000,000 triple-verified physicians, who are looking for and sharing the latest medical insights.
By joining Sermo, you can improve your medical practice and grow your professional network.

Sermo gives you access to the latest medical news so you can read, collaborate, and discuss with
your fellow professionals. The easy-to-use platform provides access to exclusive content, while
helping you keep a pulse on the latest happenings in the medical world.

The popularity of social media by physicians had been steadily and consistently growing; but in
2020—as COVID-19 completely changed the way the world communicated—the number of physicians engaging
in social media grew exponentially. Sermo experienced an 83% increase in global unique logins on its
platform alone—and a 24% increase in time spent on the site.

When physicians were asked to compare physician-only social platforms against general social media,
they said physician-only platforms offered more credibility, security, privacy, value of
information, and allowed a better connectivity with peers.

*“Sermo is an excellent tool for connecting colleagues and often helps us share our experiences and
clarify diagnostic and therapeutic doubts.”* —Sermo Member, Orthopedic Surgeon

The top 3 reasons physicians use social media professionally across all markets are:

1. Staying up to date on medical news.
2. Connecting with peers.
3. Sharing knowledge.

There’s a reason that Sermo is the number one social network for doctors, and rapidly growing. The
community is designed to help you be the best physician you can be, by providing access to thousands
of patient cases and the largest [drug ratings][47] database in the world—featuring over 1.2+
million ratings! With Sermo, you can give your patients a superior standard of care, while growing
your professional network and taking your practice to the next level.

In addition to its physician-only network, Sermo now offers exclusive, separate communities for APPs
(nurse practitioners and physician associates) and for Pharmacists. These dedicated spaces provide
tailored experiences where members can collaborate, learn, and connect with peers who understand
their unique roles in healthcare—while still enjoying access to earning opportunities through paid
medical surveys.

**How can doctors use social networking sites like Sermo?**

Social media has become an essential tool for doctors to connect with patients, colleagues, and the
wider healthcare community. By leveraging social media effectively, doctors can enhance their
practice, improve patient care, and stay informed about advancements in the medical field. So it is
important for doctors to not only maintain a professional presence on social media but also use it
as a valuable resource for their profession. With proper use of privacy settings and adhering to
ethical guidelines, doctors can leverage social media to benefit both themselves and their patients.

Some of the key benefits of using social media for doctors include building a strong online
presence, sharing valuable health information, connecting with colleagues and peers, promoting their
practice, and staying updated on industry news and developments.

**– Sharing valuable health information:** social media can also be a powerful tool for doctors to
share valuable health information and educate their patients. Through blog posts, infographics,
videos, and other visual content, doctors can inform their followers about various health topics,
offer tips for maintaining good health, and dispel any myths or misconceptions.
– **Connecting with colleagues and peers:** social media provides a professional networking
opportunity for doctors to connect with colleagues and peers from all over the world. By joining
online communities or participating in discussions on social networking sites like Sermo and
LinkedIn, doctors can exchange knowledge and insights with fellow healthcare professionals. This not
only helps them stay updated on current medical practices but also allows them to collaborate on
research projects or refer patients to specialists.
**– Promoting their practice:** social media can be an effective marketing tool for doctors to
promote their practice and attract new patients. By sharing positive patient reviews,
before-and-after photos, or success stories on professional networking platforms, doctors can build
trust and credibility among their followers. This can ultimately lead to more referrals and
appointments.
**– Staying updated on industry news and development:** finally, social media allows doctors to stay
updated on industry news and developments in real-time. Many healthcare organizations, medical
journals, and professional networking associations have a presence on social media where they share
the latest research findings, updates on medical technology, policy changes, and other important
information that may impact a doctor’s practice.

Social media has revolutionized the way we communicate and connect with others, and doctors are no
exception. With the right approach and understanding, social media can be a powerful tool for
doctors to build their online presence, educate patients, connect with colleagues, promote their
practice, and stay updated on industry news and developments. By incorporating social media into
their professional lives, doctors can improve patient care and contribute to the advancement of
healthcare as a whole. [HCPs can try Sermo out today for free][48] – you might be surprised at what
you learn!

**How can doctors maintain patient confidentiality while using social media?**

Social media has become an integral part of our daily lives, including in the medical field. Doctors
can use social media to enhance their practice, connect with colleagues and patients, and stay
informed about the latest developments in healthcare. However, it is crucial for doctors to approach
social media with a clear understanding of its benefits and risks. By leveraging social media
responsibly, physicians can foster meaningful connections, educate their audience, and promote a
more informed and engaged patient community.

Doctors should always remember that while using social media, they are still bound by the same
ethical standards as in face-to-face interactions with patients. This means maintaining patient
confidentiality and respecting boundaries at all times. Additionally, doctors should be cautious
about sharing personal opinions

## FAQs

**How can social networking benefit physicians?**

As a physician, being up-to-date on today’s medical news is essential; but remaining on the
cutting-edge of the medical world is not easy. A social network for doctors like Sermo can help
empower physicians across [medical specialties][46] to achieve their personal and professional
goals, while having fun and making meaningful connections with others.

Sermo is the only dedicated social network for doctors in the world—bringing together more than
1,000,000 triple-verified physicians, who are looking for and sharing the latest medical insights.
By joining Sermo, you can improve your medical practice and grow your professional network.

Sermo gives you access to the latest medical news so you can read, collaborate, and discuss with
your fellow professionals. The easy-to-use platform provides access to exclusive content, while
helping you keep a pulse on the latest happenings in the medical world.

The popularity of social media by physicians had been steadily and consistently growing; but in
2020—as COVID-19 completely changed the way the world communicated—the number of physicians engaging
in social media grew exponentially. Sermo experienced an 83% increase in global unique logins on its
platform alone—and a 24% increase in time spent on the site.

When physicians were asked to compare physician-only social platforms against general social media,
they said physician-only platforms offered more credibility, security, privacy, value of
information, and allowed a better connectivity with peers.

*“Sermo is an excellent tool for connecting colleagues and often helps us share our experiences and
clarify diagnostic and therapeutic doubts.”* —Sermo Member, Orthopedic Surgeon

The top 3 reasons physicians use social media professionally across all markets are:

1. Staying up to date on medical news.
2. Connecting with peers.
3. Sharing knowledge.

There’s a reason that Sermo is the number one social network for doctors, and rapidly growing. The
community is designed to help you be the best physician you can be, by providing access to thousands
of patient cases and the largest [drug ratings][47] database in the world—featuring over 1.2+
million ratings! With Sermo, you can give your patients a superior standard of care, while growing
your professional network and taking your practice to the next level.

In addition to its physician-only network, Sermo now offers exclusive, separate communities for APPs
(nurse practitioners and physician associates) and for Pharmacists. These dedicated spaces provide
tailored experiences where members can collaborate, learn, and connect with peers who understand
their unique roles in healthcare—while still enjoying access to earning opportunities through paid
medical surveys.

**How can doctors use social networking sites like Sermo?**

Social media has become an essential tool for doctors to connect with patients, colleagues, and the
wider healthcare community. By leveraging social media effectively, doctors can enhance their
practice, improve patient care, and stay informed about advancements in the medical field. So it is
important for doctors to not only maintain a professional presence on social media but also use it
as a valuable resource for their profession. With proper use of privacy settings and adhering to
ethical guidelines, doctors can leverage social media to benefit both themselves and their patients.

Some of the key benefits of using social media for doctors include building a strong online
presence, sharing valuable health information, connecting with colleagues and peers, promoting their
practice, and staying updated on industry news and developments.

**– Sharing valuable health information:** social media can also be a powerful tool for doctors to
share valuable health information and educate their patients. Through blog posts, infographics,
videos, and other visual content, doctors can inform their followers about various health topics,
offer tips for maintaining good health, and dispel any myths or misconceptions.
– **Connecting with colleagues and peers:** social media provides a professional networking
opportunity for doctors to connect with colleagues and peers from all over the world. By joining
online communities or participating in discussions on social networking sites like Sermo and
LinkedIn, doctors can exchange knowledge and insights with fellow healthcare professionals. This not
only helps them stay updated on current medical practices but also allows them to collaborate on
research projects or refer patients to specialists.
**– Promoting their practice:** social media can be an effective marketing tool for doctors to
promote their practice and attract new patients. By sharing positive patient reviews,
before-and-after photos, or success stories on professional networking platforms, doctors can build
trust and credibility among their followers. This can ultimately lead to more referrals and
appointments.
**– Staying updated on industry news and development:** finally, social media allows doctors to stay
updated on industry news and developments in real-time. Many healthcare organizations, medical
journals, and professional networking associations have a presence on social media where they share
the latest research findings, updates on medical technology, policy changes, and other important
information that may impact a doctor’s practice.

Social media has revolutionized the way we communicate and connect with others, and doctors are no
exception. With the right approach and understanding, social media can be a powerful tool for
doctors to build their online presence, educate patients, connect with colleagues, promote their
practice, and stay updated on industry news and developments. By incorporating social media into
their professional lives, doctors can improve patient care and contribute to the advancement of
healthcare as a whole. [HCPs can try Sermo out today for free][48] – you might be surprised at what
you learn!

**How can doctors maintain patient confidentiality while using social media?**

Social media has become an integral part of our daily lives, including in the medical field. Doctors
can use social media to enhance their practice, connect with colleagues and patients, and stay
informed about the latest developments in healthcare. However, it is crucial for doctors to approach
social media with a clear understanding of its benefits and risks. By leveraging social media
responsibly, physicians can foster meaningful connections, educate their audience, and promote a
more informed and engaged patient community.

Doctors should always remember that while using social media, they are still bound by the same
ethical standards as in face-to-face interactions with patients. This means maintaining patient
confidentiality and respecting boundaries at all times. Additionally, doctors should be cautious
about sharing personal opinions

# Welcome to The Non-Clinical PT!

## Maybe you’re thinking of leaving clinical care, but…

You have no idea what types of non-clinical roles are out there
You have no clue which jobs you’d enjoy
You’re worried you don’t have the right skills to transfer to a non-clinical role
You don’t think you have enough experience to make the leap
You figure all the good roles go to nurses
You have no idea where to find quality non-clinical jobs
You’re too exhausted from work to figure it out on your own

### Luckily, you don’t have to figure it out–because we’ve got your back!

## Start With Our FREE Mini Course!

**You’ll learn four secrets to landing a fulfilling non-clinical healthcare job.
Sign up for our e-mail list to get started!**

## **INTRODUCING…**

## **Non-Clinical 101**

*A fresh start…without starting over!*

[woman cheering]

Our flagship online course, now with our expert-trained AI coach to guide you through the material
and answer your questions in real time
Step-by-step guidance to navigate your non-clinical transition with confidence
Future-proofing strategies to build skills that stay valuable as healthcare and technology evolve
A strategic overview of 27 non-clinical career paths and how to get there
Life, career, and values assessments to choose the best path for you
Editable, ATS-friendly, non-clinical resume and cover letter templates tailored to every career path
in the course
Expert advice for acing your first non-clinical interview, from prep to follow-up
Simple tips for using AI and LinkedIn to show up like a pro

A private community to connect with fellow career-changers in a supportive, no-noise environment.
Our curated job board, with 300+ fresh non-clinical jobs — released to you a full week before our
public list
Lifetime access to the course and future updates

Des questions supplémentaires ?

[Bouton +]
What is VR?

VR by Virtualis is a portfolio of medical devices (software and platforms) that can be easily
integrated into your practice to treat multiple applications: traumatology, orthopedics,
proprioception, neurology, chronic pain, sport medicine and performance, balance, vestibular, motion
sickness, etc.

[Bouton +]
How will VR optimize my practice?

VR will help you to quantify and measure your patient's progresses and recovery. Starting from an
accurate assessment, you will be able yo generate easy and fast reports and to define the
rehabilitation protocol choosing between all the varied available exercises. Your patients are more
motivated and engaged in their rehabilitation and they recover faster.

[Bouton +]
What is the benefits of rehabilitation platforms?

What are the benefits of a rehabilitation force plate with integrated VR? Objectively analyze the
supports of your patients in physiological conditions is key during a rehabilitation treatment
(limits of stability, unilateral stance, weight distribution…). Virtualis Dynamic and Static
rehabilitation force plates, MotionVR and StaticVR, will enable you to measure the global balance
strategy (LOS, Adaptation Test, Motor Control Test, SOT…) and then provide with the best
rehabilitation protocol. Force plates + VR = the win win combo

Why VR makes rehabilitation faster ?

patients. The diversion of attention of your patients thanks to VR, keeps them focused on the task
to achieve and not on their pain or pathology: greater outcomes come faster! The real time adaption
of the solution depending on the patient condition enable a precise, efficient and sustainable
recovery.

## How It Works

## 01

## Request an Appointment 

Book your appointment by filling out the contact form at the top of the screen. Not sure if we’re
the right fit? Schedule a complimentary 15minute consultation to discuss your needs and the best
approach.



## 02

## Initial Evaluation 

Once requested, we will call you to schedule your initial evaluation and then email you with a
secure link to fill out your private health information (PHI). Your evaluation will be conducted in
your home or through a secure telehealth platform, ensuring personalized care and convenience.

## 03

## Personalized Treatment Plan 

Based on your evaluation, we’ll create a tailored treatment plan to meet your health and wellness
goals, adapting as you progress. Schedule weekly or bi-weekly follow-ups. Each session includes
targeted exercises, mobility work, and education for sustainable improvement.
